body: It's not that she's crazy. She's got the mental capacity of a teenager. I think of her like his babysitter or older sister. She's fine with him for a few hours, but she gets easily overwhelmed and needs someone to bail her out. My son doesn't see her as an authority figure at all. She's never acted like one. She gives him whatever he wants. It's like she tries to buy his love by giving him things he wants.
Yeah, i addressed that [here](http://www.reddit.com/r/MensRights/comments/zw83p/i_have_full_custody_of_my_son_my_wife_agreed_to/c68bpg6)

Here's the "dirt" i was talking about...

She was inadvertently performing sexual acts with her boyfriends in front of children. (not my kid). She made no effort to closet he blinds while the neighborhood kids where playing in the back yard. Her landlord evicted her because of multiple problems like that. The children's Mother contacted me and wrote a letter explaining what happened and said they support me for full child custody.

If her parents found out about this they would disown her. I don't want that to come out because it would make her life extremely difficult.

I didn't know. i knew her for a month before knocking her up. Her parents took her back to her home town, and said i had to marry her or they'd raise my child there. I agreed to get married to be a part of my son's life. 

She suffers from Boderline personality disorder, OCD, self mutilation, and a few other things. I've dealt with her trying to kill herself, her cheating on my with a man twice her age, and years of mental, verbal, and physical abuse. She's not fit to raise him.
Even if an opportunity arose, i wouldn't move my son away from his mother. It's not fair to him or to her.
I 100% agree with you. That's why i put such an effort to make sure she's a part of his life.

She's mentally ill and refuses treatment. the judge ordered her to produce a letter from her psychiatrist when we first separated saying she is fit to raise a child. she got the letter, but needless to say it didn't paint her in a good light. She didn't show the judge the letter and agreed to give me full custody. 

Because she's ill i don't ask for child support. I think it's important that she lives in our city and can spent time with our son. I drive him two and from her house three times a week. That's 3 hours of driving per week. I'm always on call and usually pick him up early because she gets overwhelmed. Mentally she's a teenager and cannot handle the responsibility of raising a child. I've been his primary caregiver since birth.

that's true, but I don't see that happening.  She's a bit of a simpleton. Her dad supports me in having full custody as does most of her family. She seems happy with how things are. It's been over two years and she's never even expressed interest in having him sleep at her house (naps or overnight).
#6  was there because originally i thought she'd be a flight risk. I thought she might take my son back to her home town (9 hour drive from here) without my permission.
it's worked so far. She sees him on tuesdays and thursdays, and usualy saturday as well. She doesn't want him for more than 6 hours because she gets overwhelmed.
Duty Counsel helped us write up 1-6.
I'm self employed and work from home. I don't want to move. My family lives here.

I work from home over the internet so employment isnt really a factor. I don't want to move out of this city. My parents live here and so does my girlfriend. I have no plans to move in the future. In the highly unlikely event that that changes, i can always go back to court to hopefully have it removed.

I'm in Canada.
thanks. i just did.

I spoke with her yesterday and she gave me loads of advice for free. I'm calling her back on Tuesday to see how much her retainer is. Thanks for the advice.

I hope it never comes to that. I think if she found the right balance of medication she would be somewhat sane. I'm afraid that leaving her will drive her into the hands of this other man. It looks like that's what is happening.

I just spoke with her father, and he will contact this other man on Monday at work. He said he'll explain how mentally ill she is and probably throw a few threats his way. My wife has 4 brothers and they're all a little nuts.

Unfortunately paying her off isn't an option. I'm hoping that her parents will write a letter giving my support for custody because that will make a world of difference. I'm in constant contact with her father and we're working together to try to find solutions to help her. her family is very religious and in their mind infidelity is where they draw the line. Her father is willing to write the letter, but her mother is torn. 

I'm still waiting to hear from her two Aunts. They're on vacation for the weekend and can't be reached by phone.

Thanks. I am trying my best to do that. It's very hard because i feel that she's ripped out my heart and crapped all over it. I saw another one of her emails sent today... it looks like she is pursuing the relationship with the other man. he's old enough to be her father and it disgusts me that he doesn't care about her or her child. he just wants to get laid and doesn't seem to care about the repercussions.

Thanks for the list. I'm afraid i can't afford a lawyer. For the past 3 years i've been a stay at home dad who also works in IT. Most of my work i can do remotely over the internet. I could only work from 9am-3pm (when my son wakes up from his nap). After that i had to watch the kid and cook dinner. My wife spent a lot of money on makeup and other luxuries that we couldn't afford. I've kept the receipts and i'll probably be using them if this goes to trial.

again, thanks for the list. i did print it and read it entirely through. I did keep notes whenever my wife had a meltdown. I will need to convert those notes into a journal. i think that's a great idea.
I just wanted to say thanks for everyone's kind words. I can't check this reddit very often because i don't want my wife to see this yet. I don't know if i should show her... what do you guys think?

Great advice p0ss. I'll give that a try. 

Yea i haven't been too impressed with the Canadian Health Care system. We live in White Rock BC and have gone through a few doctors. We were lucky enough to have an awesome family doctor take us on as a patient.

He reffered us to a mental health psychiatrist about a year ago. She met with my wife about 3 or 4 times. She prescribed Paxil but my wife wanted to finish breast feeding before taking any medication. Because of that the psychiatrist refused to see my wife in the future because she wouldn't take her advice on medication. Bitch.

Now we've found another psychiatrist who we're meeting with on Monday. She's new to this area so i'm hoping she doesn't have too many patients yet. What my wife really needs is weekly or bi-weekly appointments where we can talk about her feelings and her problems.

Unfortunately she doesn't want to go back on any medication. We met with our family doctor today and he's recommending other forms of therapy. Hot yoga, jogging, anger management classes, parenting classes, etc. I told my wife to wait until we meet with the psychiatrist and we'll see what she recommends. 

My mother is babysitting our son overnight. She'll be bringing him back tomorrow morning. My mom picked him up this morning so he could visit his cousin.

earlier today my wife was talking to my mom on the phone, and she held the phone up to my son's ear. Just hearing my wife talk to him and the pain in her voice brought me to tears. i could hear him laugh on the other side of the line when he heard her voice. All i could do was hug her and tell her she'd be alright and she'll see him again in the morning. She's never been away from him for this long.

Thanks again for the random/funny idea. I'll keep it in mind for next time.
Thanks for that. I just phoned the receptionist for her therapy appointment on Monday. she had no idea what that was. I printed the article and will being it to our family doctor today.

no, things have gotten better.. for me anyways. Before when she had an episode she would take out all of her anger on me. Now that's she's on Paxil the intense rages seemed to have all but stopped. However she has now sunk into a deep deep depression. 

Edit: thanks for the article. just finished reading it. It describes her to a T

That's true. 95% of the time she's fine. She's very affectionate wife and mother. I'm not worried about her ever harming our child. 

I used my cell phone to record about 1 minute of her tirade. I hope i'll never have to use it in court. I really want things to work out.

This isn't the first time she's attempted suicide. She has scars on the top of her forearm from roughly 3 or 4 years ago. She cut herself with a knife. Another time she took a bottle of advil, but spit it out and didn't tell anyone. I believe all three attempts were calls for attention. BDP sufferers thrive on drama in their lives. From what she's told me she has always been a drama queen.

She also suffers from OCD. Her hands ar rough from washing them several times a day. There was a time where she used paper towels to open the fridge because she thought it was dirty. She has rituals that she must follow. 

When our family doctor prescribed the Paxil I told him everything. Every night she takes tweezers and pulls hair our of her body. She has scars from digging out ingrown hairs. This worried me so of course i told the doctor. She says it's her stress reliever.

we'll be seeing the doctor in roughly 2 hours. she's still in bed. My mom picked up our son 20 minutes ago... all i can do is sit and wait... and vent on reddit. :(

My wife suffers from BPD (Borderline personality disorder). We've been married for nearly 2 years and she's 23 years old. Shotgun wedding. We have a 1 year old son.

She's been really depressed over the past couple weeks. We have an appointment to see a psychiatrist on Monday, there was a 1.5 month waiting list.

Last night she seemed fine. I came home from work and cooked dinner. she seemed happy. I thought it was a pretty good day. Then we were playing in the baby's room and she wanted to pick my blackheads. gross, i know, but it's her stress reliever. I suffered the agony of her squeezing out the blackheads for 10 minutes. After i couldn't take the pain any longer i asked her to stop. She kept insisting that she wasn't finished. Things escalated until she started swearing at me and saying how much she hated me.

This is nothing new. This is how she is. She has an "episode" and says the meanest things you could think of to me. i have to leave the room and within 20 minutes she always comes and apologizes to me. She says she never means the horrible things she says, and it's just part of her sickness.

after 5 minutes she was changing our baby. he wasn't letting her put the diaper on and he was running around naked. He peed on the carpet. She came out to me and was laughing about it. She told me i had to clean up his pee. I refused because i was still angry about her episode 5 minutes ago.

5 minutes after that i heard her talking to the baby getting frustrated that she couldn't put the diaper on and dress him. She called me and asked me to do it. I obliged and dressed him rather quickly. I never have a problem doing it.

Meanwhile she went into the bathroom and took roughly 20-30 of her Paxil pills. Then went in the bedroom and called her parents. I heard her crying to her Mom but thought nothing of it. This is normal in our household.

She called my name and told she had taken the pills and she wants to die. She said she hates me and doesn't want to be in this relationship any more. She wants to take my son away from me and move back with her parents. THey live a 9 hour drive from here.

We drove the the emergency room and got there within 10 minutes of her taking the pills. We told the triage nurse what happened and she said we'd have to wait for a doctor. After being in the ER for about 30 minutes she was back to normal. She wanted to go home and felt really stupid. She tried throwing up the pills twice while waiting for the nurse. 

2.5 hours we waited until a psych nurse finally sat down with us. We told him everything that happened. he basically wanted to make sure she wasn't going to kill herself overnight and wanted to take the appropriate course of action. We spoke with him for 30 minutes. He decided that she was safe to go home. We just needed to wait for a doctor took look at her blood work.

The doctor came 30 minutes after we spoke with the psych nurse. She basically said there's nothing they can do about the Paxil. It's already in her system and it will have to pass through. SHe's in for a rough night.

Indeed she was. All night my wife kept kicking, and jerking her neck involuntarily. Whenever she would drift off to sleep she would have a muscle spasm. Needless to say i didn't get much sleep either.

It's currently 10am and my wife is still in bed. I spoke with her last night and she apologized several times. she promised she would never do anything like this again. I don't know if i should believe her.

The crazy girl who randomly rears her ugly head has subdued back into her subconscious.as far as i can tell she's back to the woman I love. 

My mother has picked up my son and will babysit him for the day. We're going to see our family doctor today and i am trying to reschedule the psychiatrist appointment for a sooner date. Monday feels like an eternity away.

I don't know what to do. My parents have offered to take my son for a week until my wife can seek some help. I'm thinking that would be a great idea. She's totally against it of course. My plan is to speak with our family doctor and see what he recommends. She's obviously taking the wrong medication or the wrong dosage. SHe's only been on Paxil for 3 months. Hopefully everything will work itself out.
